Package org.tweetyproject.arg.rankings.postulates

Class RaIndependence

java.lang.Object
org.tweetyproject.arg.rankings.postulates.RankingPostulate
org.tweetyproject.arg.rankings.postulates.RaIndependence
All Implemented Interfaces:
Postulate<Argument>
public class RaIndependence extends RankingPostulate
The "independence" postulate for ranking semantics as proposed in [Amgoud, Ben-Naim. Ranking-based semantics for argumentation frameworks. 2013]: The ranking between to arguments a and b should be independent of any argument that is connected to neither a nor to b.
Author:
Anna Gessler
